description.value:
You can target the nerve clusters that mask a person's true feelings. When you hit with a melee weapon attack, you may cause it to deal no damage and instead spend 1 focus point to force a Charisma saving throw against your focus save DC. On a failure, the target cannot speak a deliberate lie for 1 minute, and any Charisma check made against it during that time has advantage.

Regardless of success or failure, the target knows you tried to influence it and may simply decline to answer any question it would otherwise have lied about.
